title: --scope user with no Codex folder and no opencode file creates only ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). An empty home has no `~/.codex` and no `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md`. Creating the opencode file would stop OpenCode from falling back to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, and a Codex folder jitso makes is not a Codex install, so only `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` is created. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
